root_findings: Both actual odd slope phases satisfy the displayed degree-seven order-two recurrence, and P0+P1+P2=0 converts it exactly into the first-difference update Delta_(delta+2)=(P0/P2)Delta_delta.
Adjoining delta and Delta gives an autonomous rank-three rational translation-difference system. Translation by two is not arithmetic or geometric Frobenius.
The canonical WZ grid is a polynomial-identity certificate rather than recurrence fitting. Direct factor-degree counting makes the advertised bidegree (32,16) and boundary degree 64 conservative.
Independent recomputation from the original finite sums reproduced 47 recurrence rows, 47 orbit rows, and both exact initial states through delta 51.
The actual rows (167,5,7) and (241,1,11) reproduce P2=0 mod p, P0 nonzero mod p, p-unit adjacent slope denominators, and Delta=0 mod p. These are existence witnesses only.

The cubic endpoint factors telescope in direct iterates; the remaining numerator and denominator linear factors lie in disjoint translation-by-two root classes. Both cubic factors have no root modulo 31.

The slope update does not update every entry of the complete two-row matrix R_(r,s). The full fixed-Frobenius collision, a compatible lisse or crystalline realization, uniform conductor, monodromy, and local density all remain open.
Direct iterate degree growth is a scoped coordinate-complexity theorem and is not an impossibility theorem for alternative lisse or dynamical realizations.
